Sandbox_TrailerCargo_ItemSpill: Items spill from a tipped trailer
Sandbox_TrailerCargo_ItemSpill_tooltip: On: a trailer or pickup that tips over drops its cargo onto the ground. Off: the cargo stays in the trunk. Each player's own Spill on flip option still applies when this is on.
Sandbox_TrailerCargo_CarSpill: Cars spill from a rolled car trailer
Sandbox_TrailerCargo_CarSpill_tooltip: On: cars loaded on the W900 car trailer are thrown off when it rolls. Off: they stay loaded. Each player's own Spill on flip option still applies when this is on.
Sandbox_TrailerCargo_CarSpillDamage_tool: Multiplies the damage a car takes when it lands after a spill. 1.0 is normal, 0.0 none, 2.0 double.
